briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 escalate frontier model race with breakthrough reasoning gains

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs continue rapid iteration on next-generation models amid intensifying US-China competition. Compute constraints and safety concerns are shaping deployment strategies across the ecosystem.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with advanced multi-step reasoning capabilities while Anthropic's Claude 4 and xAI's Grok-3 push context windows beyond 2M tokens. DeepSeek-V4 closed the gap on open-source benchmarks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp and TSMC's new Arizona fabs drive 2026 H2 capacity surge. Microsoft and Google announced joint hyperscale clusters exceeding 500k H100-equivalents.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will regulatory harmonization between US, EU, and China slow or accelerate the path to AGI by 2028?
